==Modifiers==
{{Main|List of modifiers for body armours (dexterity/intelligence)}}

It is one of the four basetypes that share the same 2D art. The other three are {{il|Crypt Armour}}, {{il|Carnal Armour}} and {{il|Necrotic Armour}}.
